title: Principal Engineer
jobDescription:
Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Lead procurement strategy for major electrical packages or across multiple EPC projects • Manage end-to-end procurement for key electrical packages, including: o Electrical Equipment: Transformers, switchgear (HT/LT), MCC panels, VFDs, control panels o Cables & Accessories: Power and control cables (HT/LT), cable trays, glands, lugs, terminations o Lighting & Fixtures: Industrial lighting, floodlights, poles, emergency lighting systems o Earthing & Lightning Protection: Earthing conductors, rods, pits, surge protection devices • Float and manage RFQs, conduct technical and commercial bid evaluations, and lead vendor negotiations • Coordinate with engineering and site teams to align procurement with technical specifications and delivery schedules. • Issue purchase orders (POs) ensuring compliance with project budget, quality, and contractual terms • Liaise with vendors for technical submittals, FATs (Factory Acceptance Tests), inspections, and documentation • Track order status, expedite deliveries, and resolve delays or quality issues and prepare report for management review , date to date update on MIS reports. • Maintain procurement trackers, vendor databases, and comparative costing sheets • Ensure adherence to internal procurement policies and project-specific requirements • Develop strategic vendor relationships and manage rate contracts or long-term agreements • Mentor junior procurement engineers and assist in team development and planning • Drive cost optimization, value engineering, and strategic sourcing initiatives Required

QUALIFICATIONS:
• Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent • 10+ years of relevant procurement experience in an EPC environment • Proven experience in sourcing and procurement of electrical systems, equipment, and bulk materials • Strong understanding of IEC/IS/IEEE/NEMA standards and electrical design drawings • Hands-on experience with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle) • Familiarity with Incoterms, logistics coordination, inspection, and quality protocols • Excellent communication, negotiation, and vendor management skills Preferred Experience: • Experience in electrical procurement for water/wastewater, infrastructure, or industrial EPC projects • Exposure to both domestic and international suppliers • Knowledge of packaging, handling, and shipping of sensitive electrical equipment

title: Sales and Marketing
jobDescription:
Role Overview The Marketing & Business Development professional will be responsible for driving business growth by engaging with clients, identifying and shaping opportunities at early project stages, and developing competitive strategies that convert opportunities into successful wins. The role requires close coordination with customers, internal teams, and external stakeholders to position the organization effectively in the market and build long-term value. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Client Engagement & Relationship Management • Act as the primary point of contact for clients, ensuring strong, ongoing engagement throughout the business development lifecycle. • Build and maintain long-term relationships with existing and prospective clients to understand their needs, priorities, and decision-making processes. • Represent the organization in client meetings, industry events, and networking forums. Early-Stage Project Identification • Track and identify projects at the conceptual and planning stages to influence project scope, specifications, and timelines. • Gather market intelligence related to upcoming projects, client strategies, and sector trends. • Coordinate with internal technical and commercial teams to align early project insights with organizational capabilities. Business Planning & Forecasting • Develop and implement business development strategies aligned with organizational goals and market opportunities. • Forecast potential business pipelines, revenue streams, and market growth based on customer opportunities. • Prepare and present periodic reports on pipeline status, market trends, and business performance. Bid Strategy & Proposal Packaging • Work closely with customers and internal teams to package bids that are competitive, compliant, and aligned with client expectations. • Manage pre-bid interactions, clarify biddable queries, and ensure timely responses to client requirements. • Support the preparation of technical and commercial proposals, including value propositions and differentiators. Stakeholder Networking & Coordination • Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including clients, consultants, partners, suppliers, and internal departments. • Coordinate with cross-functional teams (engineering, finance, legal, operations) to ensure cohesive bid and business development efforts. Competitive Positioning & Market Differentiation • Analyze competitor strategies, strengths, and weaknesses to create entry barriers and differentiation in the marketplace. • Develop unique selling propositions (USPs) and positioning strategies that enhance win probability. • Continuously monitor market dynamics to stay ahead of competition. Budgeting & Commercial Alignment • Work with customers and internal finance teams to align budgets with identified opportunities. • Support pricing strategies, cost evaluations, and commercial negotiations to ensure profitable growth. • Ensure business opportunities are pursued within approved budget frameworks and risk parameters. Required

QUALIFICATIONS:
• Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering / MBA or related field. • 12+ years experience in Marketing • From WTP Industry
